verdict.rationale: Moss's core-concepts docs describe a hybrid search mode that blends semantic and keyword retrieval in one query, weighted by an `alpha` parameter (1.0 semantic, 0.0 keyword, default 0.8). The GitHub README separately lists hybrid retrieval (semantic + keyword search) as a feature. missing for 10: documentation of the keyword scoring algorithm (BM25 or otherwise), support for sparse vectors, detail on the fusion method beyond alpha weighting (e.g. RRF), and independent or hands-on corroboration of ranking quality.
